text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The tryouts are a place for race-ready<n>Umamusume
to appeal to potential<n>trainers, which means this
"Nakayama Festa" was actually a<n>student here.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Oh nooo, I'm so nervous! This<n>time, I've gotta
win... or at least,<n>hopefully I can make top five!

text_block_list.name: Knowledgeable Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, new kid! So you did decide to<n>come check
out the tryouts, huh?<n>Anyone here catch your eye?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm curious about post 10, Nakayama Festa!

text_block_list.name: Knowledgeable Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Huh. Hmm... Nakayama Festa? Oh<n>jeez, I swear
I've heard the name<n>before, but it's escaping me.
choice_data_list:
Just wait till you see what she can do. It's
incredible!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The skill and guts she displayed at<n>the pier were
top class. With her wits,<n>I'm sure she'll put on an
amazing<n>performance today!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah... Tch!

text_block_list.name: Knowledgeable Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Hey, the runner you marked<n>doesn't seem to
be doing all so well...

text_block_list.name: Knowledgeable Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Uh oh, look. She's falling even further<n>behind. She
doesn't look all that tired<n>though, so why?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hah... hah... hahhh...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The way she ran was painfully bland,<n>earning her a
thirteenth-place finish.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I knew I shouldn't have got myhopes up. I'll have to try harder nexttime...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Next time," huh? Maybe that's<n>what's holding me
back. The thought<n>of a second chance.
Festa. Don't you worry about a thing.

I know you'll find what you seek at<n>Tracen
Academy—and you'll meet<n>people who will truly
satisfy that<n>burning desire in your heart.
I promise. You'll feel alive at Tracen.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Man. I guess it was too good to be<n>true.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The feisty spirit I saw at the pier isgone. This "Nakayama Festa" is like adifferent person. I mean, maybe sheis. Maybe she's just a lookalike witha similar name.
choice_data_list:
(Because the Nakayama I saw before could have
done so much better.)

text_block_list.name: Knowledgeable Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, new kid. Forget Festa.

text_block_list.name: Knowledgeable Trainer
text_block_list.text: I just remembered where I heardabout Nakayama Festa, and let me tellyou, you do not want to take onsomeone that difficult yet.

text_block_list.name: Knowledgeable Trainer
text_block_list.text:
She's got a reputation amongst the<n>instructors.
They try so hard to help,<n>then she blows them off. I
heard she<n>almost got expelled for causing<n>trouble
before a practice race.

text_block_list.name: Knowledgeable Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You saw how she just ran. Did it look<n>like she was
giving it her best effort?<n>You were just thinking that
she could<n>do better if she applied herself, right?

text_block_list.name: Knowledgeable Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...Well, she's not gonna apply herself.Okay, kid? You've just started yourtrainer journey. You'd both be betteroff picking someone else than putting in all your sweat and tears just to getburned.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I... I don't even know how to respond.<n>He's seen a
lot more runners than I<n>have, so I'm sure he knows
what<n>he's talking about, but...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The look on Nakayama Festa's face<n>as she leaves
the course... It's like<n>she's screaming for help.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but doubt whether she's<n>really as bad
as the rumors make her<n>out to be. Next thing I
know, I'm<n>looking up her track record.
choice_data_list:
Here they are. The results of Nakayama Festa's
recent practice races...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
They're all over the place. Sometimes<n>she's
amazing, sometimes she's<n>awful. Her average
across the board<n>isn't great, but then again, this
record<n>only shows the cold, hard numbers.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Why did she look so torn up after the<n>tryouts? Why
didn't she just run<n>harder in the race? ...I can't
even<n>begin to guess.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I close the set of records. Something<n>tells me these
numbers aren't what I<n>need right now.
choice_data_list:
I need to know more about Nakayama Festa
herself.

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
Like I friggin' said, quit bumming<n>around here every
damn day! If you<n>wanna know about Nakayama, go
ask her yourself!
choice_data_list: But she hasn't shown up to class all week...

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
That's your problem! Who knows<n>where she is?!
Damn it... Quit<n>followin' me around! Don't adults
have better stuff to do?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I shake dirt off my clothes. There<n>goes yet another
day of zero<n>progress. I haven't learned anything
meaningful about Nakayama Festa at<n>all.

Are you the trainer that's been going<n>around
asking about Nakayama? I've<n>been hearing rumors
on and off<n>campus.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli. But... that's got<n>nothing to do with
Nakayama, now<n>does it?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
C'mere. Be a good puppy and follow<n>my lead—I'll
give you exactly what<n>you've been longing for.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
This is a freestyle racecourse. It's a<n>casual place
for people who just<n>want to run without all the
rules and<n>regulations.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Them, and the freaks who like<n>running on messy,
unkempt grass<n>like this. Nakayama used to play
around here, from what I've heard.
choice_data_list: So this is where she's been?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Were you listening? I said she usedto hang here. Not anymore though—orso she says.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: What, so you are back already? Sincewhen do you keep curfew? I thoughtyou lived for your little games.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...I'm finally ready to run in the<n>tryouts, so I cleaned
up my act.<n>That's all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
From here out, I'll have real races. I'll<n>be staking
my entire future on the big<n>thrills... taking
mind-breaking risks<n>with my whole body on the
line. I<n>don't need the small fry anymore.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
All bark and no bite. Tch. And here I<n>thought she'd
show me something<n>entertaining.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Listen well. You wanna know<n>Nakayama's
Achilles heel? Go visit<n>her old mentor at the
hospital. She'd<n>know.
choice_data_list: Her old mentor... at the hospital?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, one of my groupies used to go<n>to school with
Nakayama before<n>Tracen. She was practically
begging<n>to give me info.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So, now I've got the hospital name<n>and contact info.
What you do with<n>it's up to you.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Sirius thrusts a piece of paper into my<n>hand. I start
to thank her, but she just<n>turns and leaves with a
little "Tch."
choice_data_list:
In any case... that mentor might know what's
holding Nakayama Festa back.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm a little worried why she has a<n>mentor at a
hospital, though. Her<n>physician, maybe? Did she
have an<n>injury? An illness?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But then, when I arrive for our<n>meeting, I find the
mentor in patients'<n>garb, resting on a hospital bed.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
Yes, or her old elementary school<n>teacher, rather.
She had me for fifth<n>grade, and hehe... she certainly
was a<n>handful.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
There are some things you should<n>know about her,
but before we get<n>into that, there's something I'd
like<n>you to watch.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'd like to show you her strong<n>points first,
before we dig into the<n>nitty-gritty. I've got a video
from two<n>years ago...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
The first time Festa took on the world<n>with her own
two feet.
